meta.title: Herdr
meta.description: Observe and drive Herdr workspaces, panes, and agents from DeepSeek Harness.

brand.heroText: Herdr helps you explore the unknown
brand.presetDesc: Binds the session to Herdr: the conversation runs as an Agent inside Herdr, its status shows live in the Herdr sidebar, and herdr tools operate workspace / pane / agent.
pane.closeConfirm: Close pane {id}? Its process will be terminated
panel.selfTitle: {id} (this conversation) · Click to locate in Herdr
view.dropHint: Dragging only reorders within the same workspace
global.title: Herdr Dashboard
dashboard.paneMultiple: {count} panes in this group, cannot locate a specific pane
view.installBody: The panel talks to the herdr headless server over its socket. Start it (or use the start button in the banner), then refresh. Install herdr:
pane.terminalKeyUnsupported: This key is not confirmed by the terminal protocol
pane.terminalControlledByOther: Terminal is controlled by another client
pane.confirmTakeoverHint: This will disconnect the current controller
dashboard.paneJumpTitle: {id} · Click to jump to its session
panel.viewerSelfDisabled: This conversation pane cannot be previewed
error.terminalBootstrapFailed: Failed to load the terminal snapshot
terminal.conflict: Terminal is controlled by another session
terminal.notFound: Terminal session not found or closed
terminal.forbidden: Not allowed to control this terminal
terminal.backpressure: Terminal input is backed up, try again shortly
setup.title: Installation & settings
setup.hostNotice: These checks target the machine running DeepSeek Harness, not the computer running your browser.
setup.noReport: No results yet. Run an environment check.
setup.cli.unusable: File found, but version check failed
setup.disconnected: No response on the configured socket; the server may be stopped or connection settings may differ
setup.windows: This Windows host architecture is not supported. Native Windows support requires x64 or arm64; on other architectures run Herdr and DeepSeek Harness together inside the same WSL distribution.
setup.unsupported: This host platform or architecture is not supported. Consult the official documentation instead of running another platform’s commands.
setup.protocolMismatch: The server protocol differs from the plugin baseline {expected}; connectivity does not establish tool or terminal compatibility.
setup.versionWarning: The verified baseline is Herdr {version}. The official installer may provide a newer release; other versions have not completed this plugin’s acceptance tests.
setup.noStop: Running servers are never automatically stopped, upgraded or replaced.
setup.noNpmHerdr: Herdr does not document an official npm installer. The npm commands below install pnpm and DeepSeek Harness, not Herdr itself.
setup.manualInstall: Copy commands into a terminal on the host shown above, then run the check again. This page does not execute installers. The official installer selects the current official release; see the plugin baseline below.
setup.npmMissing: npm was not found on the host. Install or repair a Node.js distribution that includes npm before using npm commands.
setup.command.pnpm: Install pnpm (required by the plugin installer)
setup.command.dsh: Install a pinned DeepSeek Harness release (optional)
setup.command.path: Add the install directory and check the version
setup.dshWarning: This optional command selects a preview release. Checking Herdr does not require reinstalling the current host. Restart after changing the host version.
setup.officialDocs: Official Herdr installation and manual downloads
setup.configNotice: These are the paths used for checks, server start and terminals. Edit the plugin binary, socket or session configuration and restart the host to change them. This page does not silently rewrite configuration or interrupt sessions.
setup.notFound: Not found; install Herdr or configure its binary path
setup.pathHelp: Check again after installation. When the host cannot find the install directory, update its PATH and restart. Custom installations can set terminalSession.binPath in the plugin configuration.
setup.startFailed: Start failed. Check the binary path, permissions and socket configuration, then run the check again.
setup.checkFailed: The host check could not complete. Confirm the plugin connection and retry.
setup.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the command manually.
